item_name: Rothco ABS Mich-2000 Replica Tactical Helmet
item_short_desc: Rothco’s ABS MICH-2000 Replica Tactical Helmet is crafted with ABS plastic for a lightweight option that offers long-lasting durability, ideal for outdoor activities, costumes, and more. Its lightweight and comfortable design features 7 removable cushion pads for maximum comfort. The interior is lined with hook fields for attaching pads, while the adjustable nylon chin strap ensures a secure fit. Designed for adults, the helmet accommodates head sizes from 6 ¾ inches to 7 ¾ inches.
